name: Blue Style Mastery
Text: Once per Combat, you may discard a card from your hand to stop a physical or energy attack. If that card is a Blue Style card, lower your opponent's anger 2 levels.

name: Blue Style Mastery
Text: All energy attacks you perform do +1 life cards of damage. All Blue Style energy attacks gain, "If successful, raise your anger 1 level."

name: Blue Style Mastery
Text: All of your Blue Style physical attacks do +2 life cards of damage. During your "Defender Defends" phase you may remove any amount of Blue Style cards in your discard pile from the game instead of using a Defense. Prevent 2 life cards of damage from the attack for each Blue Style card removed.

name: Blue Style Mastery
Text: (This is an MRP of the Trunks Saga Blue Style Mastery.) Your opponent must reach 6 anger to advance a personality level. All of your Blue Style attacks again "If successful, raise or lower your opponent's anger 1 level."

name: Blue Swift Dodge
Text: Stops a physical attack. Lower your opponent's anger 1 level.

name: Blue Terror
Text: Energy attack doing 3 life cards of damage. If you declared Tokui-Waza, search your Life Deck for any 1 card and place it in your hand. Remove from the game after use. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Blue Thrusted Blast
Text: Endurance 3. Energy attack doing 5 life cards of damage. If successful, your Main Personality's PUR is considered to be +2 until the end of your next turn.

name: Blue Thrusting Fist Strike
Text: Physical attack. If successful, Combat ends after damage is dealt. Remove from the game after use. If Saibaimen are anywhere in play, discard this card instead of removing it from the game after use.

name: Blue Thunder Flash
Text: Sensei Deck. Energy attack doing 5 life cards of damage. If you declared a Tokui-Waza and your opponent declared a Red Tokui-Waza, raise your anger 2 levels.

name: Blue Torso Strike
Text: Sensei Deck. Physical attack doing +2 power stages of damage. If you declared a Tokui-Waza and your opponent has used a Combat card earlier this Combat, place the bottom 2 cards of your Life Deck into your hand. Remove from the game after use.

name: Blue Total Resistance
Text: Endurance 1. Choose a Drill in play, and remove it from the game. Your Main Personality and your Allies gain 2 power stages. Raise your anger 1 level. Remove from the game after use.

name: Blue Trapped Strike
Text: Physical attack. If successful, discard a Non-Combat card or Ally in play. If either "Namek Dragon Ball 3" or "Namek Dragon Ball 4" is in play, this attack stays on the table to be used X more times this Combat. X = Your Main Personality's current level. Remove from the game after use.

name: Blue Trickster Drill
Text: Resist. Once per combat when 1 of your Blue style attacks is stopped, you may discard a card from your hand to put the stopped attack back into your hand.

name: Blue Upward Block
Text: Sensei Deck. Stops a physical attack. If you declared a Tokui-Waza and your opponent declared a Saiyan Tokui-Waza, look at your opponent's hand and choose a Physical Combat card. The chosen card is discarded.

name: Blue Videl's Knee Bash
Text: Sensei Deck. Physical attack doing +4 power stages of damage. If this attack is performed against a Majin, this attack does +7 life cards of damage instead. Raise your anger 1 level.

name: Blue Villains Drill
Text: Villains only. During your "Attacker Attacks" phase, you may discard one of your Non-Combat/Non-Drill cards in play to discard the top 3 cards of your opponent's Deck.

name: Blue Weaving
Text: Stops a physical attack. If you declared a Tokui-Waza, for the remainder of Combat, when taking life cards of damage from a physical attack, all cards in your Life Deck with no Endurance gain Endurance 3. Remove from the game after use. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Blue Windup Blast
Text: Energy attack doing 1 life card of damage for each Uncommon card in your discard pile, to a maximum of 10 life cards.

name: Blue Wrist Block
Text: Stops a physical attack. Discard one of your opponent's Non-Combat cards.

name: Blue Yamcha's Spirit Shot
Text: Focused energy attack doing 1 life card of damage. This attack does +X life cards of damage, where X= your Main Personality's PUR. Until the end of your next turn, your Main Personality gains +2 PUR.

name: Blueprints
Text: Set all personalities with the word "Android" in their card title to 0 power stages. They may not gain power stages until the beginning of your next turn.

name: Body Slam
Text: Physical attack doing +5 power stages of damage. If successful, for the remainder of Combat, your opponent must discard 1 card from his hand before each physical attack he performs. Your Main Personality gains 4 power stages.

name: Bojack
Text: Constant Combat Power: (If Bojack is your Main Personality your Allies can use this Constant Combat Power.) Personalities with the Bojack Unbound Subset Symbol can take control of Combat, even if this personality is 2 power stages above 0 or higher. All of your attacks do +1 power stages of damage for each Ally in play with the Bojack Unbound Subset Symbol.

name: Bojack's Defensive Shield
Text: Bojack only. Stops an energy attack. Stops all of your opponent's energy attacks for the remainder of Combat. Remove from the game after use.

name: Bojack's Double-Palmed Blitz
Text: Bojack only. Energy attack doing 6 life cards of damage. For the remainder of Combat, damage from your attacks cannot be prevented. If you have at least 2 Allies in play with the Bojack Unbound Subset Symbol, this card stays on the table to be used 1 more time this Combat. Remove from the game after use.

name: Bojack's Extreme Assailment
Text: Focused energy attack doing 5 life cards of damage. Set all player's anger levels to 2. If successful, you may shuffle any of your Allies that are removed from the game that have the Bojack Unbound Subset Symbol into your Life Deck. Remove from the game after use.

name: Bojack's Left Palm Charge
Text: Energy attack doing 5 life cards of damage. If successful, attach this card to one of your personalities. While attached, any energy attacks the attached personality performs do +2 life cards of damage.

name: Bojack's Overhead Toss
Text: Energy attack doing 6 life cards of damage. Lower your opponent's anger 3 levels. If used by Bojack and your opponent has 5 or more Non-Combat cards in play, your opponent discards his Non-Combat cards one at a time until he has 4 Non-Combat cards in play.

name: Bojack, the Notorious
Text: Constant Combat Power: (If Bojack is your Main Personality your Allies can use this Constant Combat Power.) Personalities with the Bojack Unbound Subset Symbol can take control of Combat, even if this personality is 2 power stages above 0 or higher. Any attacks performed by personalities with the Bojack Unbound Subset Symbol are focused attacks.

name: Bojack, the Villainous
Text: Constant Combat Power: (If Bojack is your Main Personality your Allies can use this Constant Combat Power.) Personalities with the Bojack Unbound Subset Symbol can take control of Combat, even if this personality is 2 power stages above 0 or higher. All of your attacks do +3 power stages of damage, and life cards of damage from the attacks are removed from the game instead of discarded.

name: Boomstick
Text: Physical attack doing 5 life cards of damage. Raise your or your opponent's anger 1 level. If "Locked On" is attached to your opponent's Main Personality, this attack cannot be stopped. Remove from the game after use.

name: Bountiful Harvest
Text: When you play this card, chose one: - Search your life deck or discard pile for a Tree of Might and place it into play. - Remove an Energetic Fruit attached to your MP to advance a personality level. You cannot win by MPPV fo the remainder of the game.

name: Bracing for Impact
Text: Endurance 3. Energy attacks do a maximum of 2 life cards and 0 power stages of damage for the remainder of Combat.

name: Breakfall
Text: Endurance 4. Use during your "Defender Defends" phase. If your personality currently in control of Combat has "Android" in the title, all cards in your Life Deck without Endurance gain "Endurance 3" until the beginning of your next "Attacker Attacks" phase.

name: Breakthrough Drill
Text: Cards that end Combat may not be played or used while this drill is in play.

name: Breakthrough Drill
Text: Sensei Deck. Cards that end Combat including Dragon Balls may not be played or used while this Drill is in play. This Drill affects all players.

name: Broken Scouter
Text: Your power level was miscounted. Raise it to full power. Discard this from the game after use.

name: Broly
Text: Constant Combat Power: When you perform an attack, raise your anger 1 level. If Goku is in play, raise your anger 2 levels instead.

name: Broly Unleashed
Text: Energy attack doing 8 life cards of damage. Costs 3 power stages to perform. Damage from this attack cannot be prevented. If successful, and you have 3 or more anger, you may advance a personality level. If you do, set your anger to 0. You cannot win by Most Power Personality Victory.

name: Broly's Energy Burst
Text: Energy attack doing 6 life cards of damage. Lower your opponent's anger 2 levels.

name: Broly's Evil Drill
Text: Villains only. When entering Combat as the active player, you may search your Life Deck for a "Villains only" card and place it into your hand. If Broly is your Main Personality, you may also use this Drill when entering Combat as the opposing player. You can only have 1 "Broly's Evil Drill" in play at a time.

name: Broly's Glacier Smash
Text: Physical attack doing 3 life cards of damage. If successful, your opponent's MP loses 2 power stages. If used by Broly, and your anger level is 2 or more, this card stays in play to be used 2 more times this combat.

name: Broly's Might
Text: Energy attack doing 6 life cards of damage. If used by Broly, your opponent cannot use Combat cards for the remainder of Combat. Remove from the game after use.

name: Broly's Overwhelming Attacks
Text: Broly only. Physical attack doing +4 power stages of damage. If the top 2 cards of your discard pile are Saiyan Style cards, this is a focused attack and for the remainder of Combat damage from your attacks cannot be prevented.

name: Broly's Supreme Power
Text: Broly only. Stops a physical attack or energy attack. This card stays on the table to be used 1 more time this Combat. If used a second time this Combat, remove it from the game. At the end of Combat, if this card is used only once this Combat, shuffle it back into your Life Deck. Limit 2 per deck.

name: Broly, Coming Undone
Text: Constant Combat Power: Any time a player performs a successful attack, rasie your anger 1 level. Any time you reach 5 anger draw a card.

name: Broly, Empowered
Text: Constant Combat Power: All your Saiyan Style attacks that do not remove themselves from the game after use are placed at the bottom of your Life Deck after use.

name: Broly, Furious Instinct
Text: Constant Combat Power: Whenever your opponent is skipped or passes, raise your anger 1 level. All attacks you perform deal +X power stages of damage, where X= your current anger level +1.

name: Broly, Gentle Giant
Text: Stops a physical or energy attack. Your next attack gains "If Successful, raise your anger 2 levels."

name: Broly, Learning to Fight
Text: Constant Combat Power: All attacks you perform deal +X power stages of damage, where X= your current anger level. Whenever your opponent performs a successful attack, raise your anger 1 level.

name: Broly, Super Saiyan
Text: Physical attack doing +4 power stages of damage. If the top card of your discard pile is a Saiyan Style card the first time you perform this attack each Combat, then this attack may be used a second time this Combat, and all attacks you perform do +2 life cards of damage for the remainder of Combat.

name: Broly, Super Saiyan
Text: Physical attack doing +4 power stages of damage. Raise your anger 1 level. For the remainder of Combat, all your Saiyan Style attacks do +1 life cards of damage.

name: Broly, the Calm
Text: Constant Combat Power: At the beginning of your Rejuvenation Step, if the top card of your discard pile is a Saiyan Style card, raise your anger 2 levels. If Goku is in play, raise your anger 3 levels instead, and shuffle the bottom 2 Saiyan Style cards of your discard pile into your Life Deck.

name: Broly, the Electrified
Text: When entering Combat, seearch your Life Deck for a Saiyan Style card and place it into your hand.

name: Broly, the Enraged Saiyan
Text: Constant Combat Power: When entering Combat and the top card of your discard pile is a Saiyan Style card, you may remove it from the game to raise your anger 2 levels and for the remainder of Combat, all physical attacks you perform do +2 power stages of damage.

name: Broly, the Ferocious
Text: Physical attack doing +4 power stages of damage. For the remainder of Combat, all of your Saiyan Style attacks do +3 power stages of damage, damage from your Saiyan Style attacks cannot be prevented, and life cards of damage from Saiyan Style attack are removed from the game after use instead of discarded.

name: Broly, the Gentle
Text: Constant Combat Power: Whenever your anger level is raised, double the amount of anger you are raising.

name: Broly, the Legendary Saiyan
Text: This power may only be used once per game. Shuffle the top 15 Saiyan Style cards in your discard pile back into your Life Deck.

name: Broly, the Unbeatable
Text: Physical attack doing +5 power stages of damage. This power may be used a second time this Combat. For the remainder of Combat, when your opponent plays a Combat card, he must remove the top 2 cards of his Life Deck from the game.

name: Broly, the Unstoppable
Text: Constant Combat Power: When entering Combat, you may discard a card in your hand. If you do, for the remainder of Combat any Saiyan Style attacks your Broly performs are focused attacks.

name: Brothers in Training
Text: Endurance 3. Search your Life Deck for a Drill and place it in play.

name: Bubbles
Text: Tuff Enuff Only. Constant Combat Power: When an attack you perform with a Tuff Enuff only card becomes successful, name a Non-Dragon Ball card. Your opponent searches his Life Deck for 1 copy of that card and discards it.

name: Bubbles
Text: Tuff Enuff Only. Constant Combat Power: Speediness - Whenever an attack you perform with a Tuff Enuff only card becomes successful, choose 3 Tuff Enuff only cards in your discard pile and shuffle them into your Life Deck.

name: Bubbles
Text: Tuff Enuff Only. Constant Combat Power: Physical attack doing +3 power stages of damage. Shuffle up to 3 Tuff Enuff only cards in your discard pile into your Life Deck. Draw a card.

name: Bubbles Drill
Text: When entering Combat, name a card. That card cannot be played for the remainder of Combat. Discard 1 life card when you name the card. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Bujin
Text: Energy attack doing 6 life cards of damage. If successful, you may discard a card from your hand to choose either Physical Combat, Energy Combat, or Combat cards. For the remainder of Combat, your opponent cannot use that card type unless his Main Personaliy is 5 power stages above 0 or higher.

name: Bulma
Text: Scientific Defense . Reduces the damage done by an energy attack by 2 life card draws.

name: Bulma
Text: Bulma may capture a dragon ball from her opponent if she does damage in an energy attack.

name: Bulma and Chi-Chi's Stare Off
Text: At the end of this Combat Step, the Main Personality that has the most power stages above 0 raises his anger 2 levels (if there is a tie, nobody raises his hand). If used by Chi-Chi or Bulma, you cannot win by the MPP victory for the remainder of the game, and you advance your Main Personality 1 personality level. Remove from the game after use.

name: Bulma Finds a Dragon Ball
Text: When the Bulma ally is in play, use this card to capture a Dragon Ball. Discard from the game after use. This card is not treated as a Dragon Ball.

name: Bulma Finds a Drill
Text: When the Bulma ally is in play, pick a drill from the life deck or the discards and put it into play. This card is not treated as a Drill.

name: Bulma's Ingenuity Drill
Text: Cards that remain in play to be used an additional time this combat are considered Bulma named cards for card effects. Card effects that say "When the Bulma ally is in play..." are considered to say "If Bulma is your Main Personality..."

name: Bulma's Looking Good
Text: Use when entering Combat. Your opponent discards a card at random from his hand.

name: Bulma's Scouter
Text: Heroes only. Pick a dragon ball from your life deck and play it. Remove from the game after use. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Bulma's Ultimatum
Text: (You cannot choose a Main Personality, Dragon Ball, Sensei, or Mastery with this card.) Choose up to 5 cards your opponent has in play or under a card in play. Your opponent divides them into 2 piles. Choose 1 pile and shuffle it into their life deck. If Vegeta is in play, and is not your MP, end combat.

name: Bulma, the Expert
Text: Energy attack. At the end of Combat, search your Life Deck for an Ally and place it in play at 6 power stages above 0.

name: Bulma, the Wife
Text: Constant Combat Power: When one of your Bulma Named cards leaves play, your opponent discards the top 4 cards of his Life Deck. Prevent 2 life cards of damage from your opponent's energy attacks.

name: Burning Rage!
Text: Increase your anger level by 2. Take the bottom 2 cards from your discard pile and place them at the bottom of your life deck. Discard this card from the game after use.

name: Burter's Power Stance
Text: Raise any villain Main Personality to its highest power stage. Set all of his allies to five power stages above 0. Remove from the game after use.

name: Calming Sanctuary
Text: For every anger you reduce on your Warrior Sword, reduce all opponents' anger that many as well.

name: Can He Do That?
Text: Choose a personality or Non-Combat card in play. The chosen card's power cannot be used for the remainder. If an Ally was chosen, the personality cannot take control of Combat for the remainder of Combat.

name: Capsule Corp.
Text: All focused attacks cost +3 power stages to perform.

name: Capsule Corp. Ship
Text: Heroes only. Raise any personality in play to its highest power stage.

name: Captain Ginyu
Text: Physical attack doing 6 life cards of damage.

name: Captain Ginyu
Text: Defense Shield: Stops the first unstopped energy attack in Combat.

name: Captain Ginyu Changes
Text: Physical attack. If successful, also stop all opponent's physical attacks for the remainder of Combat.

name: Captain Ginyu Frog
Text: Reduce a villain 1 personality level if possible. Limit 1 per deck. Remove from the game after use.

name: Captain Ginyu Moves to Attack!
Text: Physical attack doing +3 life cards of damage. Raise your anger 1 level. Remove from the game after use.

name: Captain Ginyu Realization
Text: All opponent's and their allies lose 3 power stages. Remove from the game after use. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Captain Ginyu the Leader
Text: Constant Combat Power: When defending against a physical attack, choose any personality in play and use that power stage to determine damage.

name: Captain Ginyu Transformed
Text: Physical attack. It costs 1 life card to use. Reduce opponent's anger to 0. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Captain Ginyu's Energy Attack
Text: Energy attack. Costs 3 power stages to perform. Raise your anger 2 levels. Remove from the game after use.

name: Captain Ginyu's Reversal Drill
Text: Villains only. For every 3 power stages of damage you receive, per attack, your opponent loses 1 power stage of damage. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Captain Ginyu's Sacrifice
Text: Villains only. To end the combat, remove an ally from the game. If "Saiyan Power Drill" is in play, this card instead can be used as an energy attack.

name: Captain Ginyu's Visionary Attack
Text: Energy attack costing 1 power stage to use.

name: Carpet Attack Technique
Text: Physical attack doing 3 power stages of damage. You may discard any of your Non-Combat cards in play. For each Non-Combat card discarded, this attack does an additional +3 life cards of damage. If used by Hercule, you can wait to discard Non-Combat cards until after you know if the attack is successful or not. Remove from the game after use.

name: Catch Drill
Text: You may discard a card from your hand in place of an attack to give this Drill to your opponent. All attacks performed against you do +2 life cards of damage.

name: Caterpy
Text: Constant Combat Power: All your physical attacks do +1 power stages of damage. Power: Your opponent discards a card at random from your hand for you to draw a card. Raise your anger 1 level.

name: Caterpy, the Grappler
Text: Constant Combat Power: All your physical attacks do +2 power stages of damage. Power: When entering Combat, you may discard a Non-Combat card you have in play to raise your anger 2 levels and name a Non-Combat card. Search your Life Deck for a copy of that Non-Combat card and set it aside. That Non-Combat card comes into play at the end of the turn.

name: Caterpy, the Tenacious
Text: Constant Combat Power: All your physical attacks do +3 power stages of damage. Power: Discard a card from your hand to search your Life Deck for a card of the same card type as the card discarded, including Dragon Balls, and put it into your hand.

name: Caught in the Act
Text: Use when an Ally performs an attack or uses a power. The attack or power is stopped and the Ally is discarded.

name: Caught Off Guard Drill
Text: Heroes only. When this Drill is placed in play, name a non-Dragon Ball card. That card cannot be played or used by either player while this Drill is in play. Limit 2 per deck.

name: Celestial Battleground
Text: All focused attacks do +1 power stages and +1 life cards of damage.

name: Celestial Games Begin
Text: For the remainder of Combat, any successful attack performed by any player allows that player to capture a Dragon Ball.

name: Celestial Halo
Text: Limit 1 per deck. Before the first turn begins, if your MP is a Celestial Fighter, you may search your life deck for this card and attack it to your MP to place Grand Kai from your deck into play at 3 stages above 0. While attached, your main personality is considered to have four levels for your opponent's MPPV conditions, and your attacks deal +1 life card of damage.

name: Cell HT
Text: Constant Combat Power: Whenever your opponent uses a power or effect that lets him draw one or more cards, draw one card.

name: Cell Jr. 1
Text: Search your Life Deck or discard pile for a Cell Jr. and place it in play at 3 power stages above 0.

name: Cell Jr. 1
Text: Energy attack doing +1 life cards of damage for every Cell Jr. you control.

name: Cell Jr. 2
Text: Physical attack doing +1 power stages of damage for each Cell Jr. you control.

name: Cell Jr.'s Flight
Text: Physical attack doing +2 power stages of damage and +1 life card of damage for each Cell Jr. you have in play. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Cell Smiles
Text: Choose 1 card at random from your opponent’s hand. Your opponent shuffles that card into his Life Deck.

name: Cell's Aerial Maneuvers
Text: Physical attack doing +1 life cards of damage. For the remainder of Combat, after a player receives damage from a successful attack, he shuffled his hand into his Life Deck and then draws the same number of cards he shuffled into his Life Deck.

name: Cell's Android Absorption
Text: Cell only. If Android 17 or Android 18 is in play and they are not a Main Personality, remove one of them from the game. Raise Cell to his highest power stage.

name: Cell's Arena
Text: All attacks cost +1 power stage to perform. All successful attacks do +2 life cards of damage.

name: Cell's Backslap
Text: Physical attack. Draw  the bottom card of your discard pile and place it in your hand. Remove from the game after use. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Cell's Charge
Text: Physical attack doing +3 power stages of damage. Gain 3 power stages. If successful, you may discard up to 2 cards from your hand and then immediately draw the same number of cards.

name: Cell's Choke Hold
Text: Physical attack doing +1 life cards of damage. If successful, your opponent discards 2 cards from his Life Deck for each card in his hand.

name: Cell's Dark Attack
Text: Villains only. Energy attack doing 6 life cards of damage.

name: Cell's Defense
Text: Villains only. Stops all physical or energy attacks for the remainder of Combat. Remove from the game after use. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Cell's Domination Drill
Text: Whenever your opponent places a Battleground in play, he discards the top 3 cards from his Life Deck.

name: Cell's Draining
Text: Use when entering Combat, all of your opponent's personalities lose 2 power stages. Remove from the game after use.

name: Cell's Energy Blast
Text: Villains only. Energy attack doing 7 life cards of damage. You may not perform energy attacks for the remainder of Combat. Remove from the game after use.

name: Cell's Instant Transmission
Text: Cell only. You can use this card during your Non-Combat Step. Search your Life Deck for a Battleground or Location and place it in play. You do not have to skip Combat.

name: Cell's Last Strike
Text: Energy attack Doing 5 life cards of damage. If your opponent has 10 or less life cards in his Life Deck, this attack does 10 life cards of damage instead.

name: Cell's Neck Grab
Text: Cell only. Physical attack doing +3 power stages of damage. If successful, discard one of your opponent’s Allies in play and your opponent’s Main Personality loses 1 power stage for each power stage the Ally was at above 0.

name: Cell's Power Burst
Text: Physical attack. If successful, discard 2 of your opponent's Allies in play.

name: Cell's Power Drain
Text: Cell only. Raise your Main Personality to its highest power stage. Lower all of your opponent's Allies to 0 power stages.

name: Cell's Presence
Text: Remove all Allies in play from the game. Limit 2 per deck. Remove from the game after use.

name: Cell's Self Destruct
Text: Energy attack doing 12 life cards of damage. If successful and you don't defeat your opponent, you lose the game. Remove from the game after use. Limit 1 per deck, unless your Main Personality is Cell.

name: Cell's Style
Text: Cell Only. For the remainder of Combat, all your attacks performed by Cell do +3 life cards of damage.

name: Cell's Swift Strike
Text: Endurance 2. Physical attack. Lower your opponent's anger 2 levels. Take the top 2 cards of your discard pile and place them at the bottom of your Life Deck.

name: Cell's Threatening Position
Text: Villains only. Reduce your opponent's Main Personality to its level 1 personality card. Limit 1 per deck. Remove from the game after use.

name: Cell, Perfect
Text: Physical attack doing 7 life cards of damage. If Android 17 or Android 18 is in play this attack also does 3 power stages of damage.

name: Cell, Stage One
Text: Physical attack doing +4 power stages of damage.

name: Cell, Stage One HT
Text: Physical attack doing +3 power stages of damage. If you declared a Tokui-Waza, you may use this power twice per Combat.

name: Cell, Stage Two
Text: When entering Combat, search your Life Deck or a Physical Combat, or Energy Combat card, show it to your opponent, and place it in your hand.

name: Cell, the Destroyer
Text: Energy attack doing 9 life cards of damage.

name: Cell, the Master
Text: Energy attack doing 12 life cards of damage. Costs 0 power stages to perform.

name: Cell, the Perfect Warrior HT
Text: Physical attack doing +5 power stages of damage. If successful, raise your anger 1 level.

name: Cell, the Puppet
Text: Constant Combat Power: All Physical Combat cards in your Life Deck with no Endurance have Endurance 2.

name: Champion Belt
Text: Use only if you have used a Non-Combat card this turn that is not a Drill. Your Main Personality gains 4 power stages. Raise your anger 1 level. Draw a card.

name: Champion Drill
Text: Once per combat, in place of an attack, discard a card from your hand and draw the top two cards from your Life Deck. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Champion's Aura
Text: Endurance 1,000,000. Your opponent looks at the top 5 cards of your Life Deck and chooses 2 of them. Place those 2 cards in your hand and discard the other 3.

name: Chapuchai
Text: Physical attack doing 4 power stages of damage. If successful, prevent 4 power stages of damage from the next attack performed against you this Combat.

name: Chapuchai's Multiform
Text: Chapuchai only. Physical attack doing 1 life card of damage. This attack stays on the table to be used 4 more times this Combat. Damage from this attack cannot be modified. Remove from the game after use.

name: Chapuchai, the Tenacious
Text: Physical attack doing 3 power stages of damage. If successful, remove a Drill in play from the game. If you did not declare a Tokui-Waza, you may use this power three times per Combat.

name: Chapuchai, the Tiny
Text: Stops a physical attack. Place the bottom 2 cards of your discard pile at the bottom of your Life Deck. You may use this power twice per Combat.

name: CHARGE!
Text: Physical attack. Empower 5. This attack does +3 power stages of damage. Empower 4. Gain 4 power stages. Empower 3. Raise your anger 1 level. Empower 2. Lower your opponent's anger 3 levels. Empower 1. Shuffle any cards in your discard pile with "Charge" in the title into your Life Deck. Remove from the game after use.

name: Chazke Village
Text: When entering Combat, the attacker may search his Life Deck for an Ally and place it in play at 3 power stages above 0.

name: Chi-Chi
Text: Stops a Physical attack performed against Gohan or Goku. Chi-Chi can use this power even if your Main Personality is at 2 power stages above 0 or higher.

name: Chi-Chi
Text: Physical Attack. If successful, it also does +4 power stages of damage if Goku is present.

name: Chi-Chi
Text: Focused physical attack doing 3 power stages of damage. If Goten is in play you may use this power twice per Combat.

name: Chi-Chi on the Attack!
Text: Chi-Chi only. Your opponent discards the top 3 cards of his Life Deck. Your opponent's Main Personality loses 4 power stages. Remove from the game after use.

name: Chi-Chi Searches
Text: Physical attack. If successful also search your discard pile and Life Deck for any ally and put it into play at 6 power stages above 0.

name: Chi-Chi's Cheering Drill
Text: Sensei Deck. Heroes only. Damage from your attacks cannot be prevented by Endurance.

name: Chi-Chi, the Grandmother
Text: Constant Combat Power: Your Allies with Saiyan Heritage cannot be discarded or removed from the game. If you have 5 or more Allies in play at the beginning of your turn, advance Chi-Chi a personality level.

name: Chi-Chi, the Wife
Text: When entering Combat, remove all of your opponent's Non-Combat cards in play from the game.

name: Chiaotzu
Text: Power Blast Energy Attack costs 1 power stage to perform.

name: Chiaotzu
Text: Blast Energy Attack does 6 life cards of damage and removes Chiaotzu from the game.

name: Chiaotzu
Text: Energy Attack. If successful, Chiaotzu also stops all other opponent's physical attacks in this combat.

name: Chiaotzu
Text: Focused energy attack.

name: Chiaotzu's Drill
Text: All physical attacks performed against you, do 1 less power stage of damage, to a minimum of 0.

name: Chiaotzu's Energy Manipulation

name: Deceptive Moves

name: Defensive Stance

name: Feverish

name: Fierce Left Kick

name: Flashback

name: Flashy Move

name: Flight Training

name: Focused Sword Strike

name: Foreboding Evidence

name: Fortify Your Spirit

name: Freestyle Mastery
Text: When entering Combat, remove the top card of your discard pile from the game. If it's a Named card that matches your Main Personality, name a non-Dragon Ball card. Your opponent searches his Life Deck and discards a copy of that card.

name: Freestyle Mastery
Text: Your Drills cannot be discarded for any reason while they are in play. When entering Combat, you may discard a Named card that matches your Main Personality to search your Life Deck for a Named card that matches your Main Personality and place it into your hand.

name: Friends Help Friends

name: Goku's Plan
Text: Energy attack doing 5 life cards of damage for no power cost.

name: Goku's Power Attack
Text: Energy attack. If the personality performing this attack has "Saiyan" in the title, this attack does an additional +4 life cards of damage and is a focused attack.

name: Goku's Power Pole
Text: Goku only. Attach to your Goku in play. While attached, all of your attacks do +2 power stages of damage and gain "if successful, discard one of your opponent's Allies in play." You can only have 1 "Goku's Power Pole" attached at a time.

name: Goku's Power Strike
Text: Endurance 3. Physical attack doing +4 power stages of damage. If your Main Personality is at level 2 or above, this attack does an additional +4 life cards of damage and is a focused attack. If successful, search your Life Deck for a Drill and place it into play.

name: Goku's Quick Dodge
Text: Stops a physical attack. Raise your Main Personality to his highest power stage, and for the remainder of Combat, prevent 1 power stage of damag from all of your opponent's attacks.

name: Goku's Quick Save
Text: Use when one of your Allies is discarded or removed from the game. Any Allies being discarded or removed stay in play. End Combat. Remove from the game after use.

name: Goku's Quickness
Text: Heroes only. Stops the first physical attack in the next combat. Remove from the game after use. If "Chiaotzu's Drill" is in play this card can be used as an energy attack instead.

name: Goku's Quickness Drill
Text: If this Drill is discarded from your hand, place it into play instead. Whenever an opponent's card makes you discard a card from your hand, draw a card afterward.

name: Goku's Ready
Text: Search your Life Deck for one card, set it aside face-down, and place it in your hand at the beginning of your opponent's next turn. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Goku's Relentless Spirit
Text: Physical attack doing +2 power stages of damage. If successful, shuffle any or all of your Goku Named cards that have been removed from the game into your Life Deck. Remove from the game after use.

name: Goku's Reunion
Text: Until the end of Combat, if a card power lets you search your Life Deck for any number of Allies, you get to search for 1 additional Ally. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Goku's Right Knee Smash
Text: Physical attack doing +2 life cards of damage.

name: Goku's Righteous Force
Text: Energy attack. If successful, also draw the top 3 cards from an opponent's discard pile and remove them from the game. Remove from the game after use.

name: Goku's Running Defense
Text: Heroes only. Stops a non-focused energy attack. Stops all non-focused energy attacks performed against you for the remainder of Combat. Limit 1 per deck. Remove from the game after use.

name: Goku's Setup Strike
Text: Saiyan Heritage only. Energy attack. If successful and your opponent can win by the Most Powerful Personality Victory, lower his Main Personality 2 personality levels. Remove from the game after use.

name: Goku's Shifted Balance Drill
Text: When entering Combat as the defender, you may search your Life Deck for a card with the word "Left" in the title and place it into your hand.

name: Goku's Sudden Outburst
Text: Energy attack doing 5 life cards of damage.

name: Goku's Super Saiyan Blast!
Text: Stops an opponent's physical or energy attack. Remove from the game after use. If "Goku's Mixing Drill" is in play, this card can be used as an energy attack instead.

name: Goku's Super Saiyan Catch
Text: Endurance 1. Stops a physical attack. Raise your anger 1 level. If used by a personality with "Saiyan" in the title, raise your anger 2 levels instead and place this card at the bottom of your Life Deck.

name: Goku's Supreme Kamehameha
Text: (This card must be the first card you play during Combat.) Energy attack doing 1 power stage of damage for each Martial Arts Styled Card in your discard pile. Remove 15 Styled cards in your discard pile from the game. You cannot perform attacks for the remainder of Combat.

name: Goku's Surprise Attack
Text: Physical attack doing 5 power stages of damage.

name: Goku's Touch
Text: Use after you perform a successful physical attack to capture an opponent's Dragon Ball. Remove from the game after use.

name: Goku's Training
Text: Physical attack doing +2 power stages of damage. If successful, draw the bottom card from your discard pile. Remove from the game after use.

name: Goku's Truce
Text: Stops a successful energy or physical attack.

name: Goku, Desperate Plea
Text: (This card may only be played as an ally.) If you have Vegeta in play at the same personality level, you may fuse it with this card for a Gogeta, Fusion Reborn from your Sensei deck.

name: Goku, Earth's Hero HT
Text: When entering Combat, draw a card and show it to your opponent. If it is a Physical or Energy Combat card, your opponent discards 3 cards from the top of his Life Deck.

name: Goku, Super Saiyan
Text: Constant Combat Power: When entering Combat, if you have not used a Constant Combat Power this turn, you may remove 7 Saiyan Style cards in your discard pile from the game to raise your anger 6 levels. Prevent 2 life cards of damage from any attacks performed against you.

name: Goku, Super Saiyan 2
Text: Physical attack doing +5 power stages of damage. If the top card of your discard pile is a Goku Named card, this is a focused attack and lowers your opponent's anger 3 levels.

name: Goku, Super Saiyan 3
Text: Constant Combat Power: At the beginning of every turn choose 2 of your Goku's lower personality levels. For the remainder of that turn, Goku has the Powers and Constant Combat Powers of the chosen 2 levels.

name: Goku, Super Saiyan 4
Text: Power: When entering combat, draw a card. Power: Use one of your lower level personality powers.

name: Goku, Super Saiyan Ascended
Text: Constant Combat Power: All of your Non-Drill Saiyan Style cards that do not remove themselves from the game after use are places at the bottom of your Life Deck after use. All of your Saiyan Style attacks do an additional +2 life cards of damage.

name: Goku, Super Saiyan God
Text: (You may only advance to this level via "God Ki Ritual". If your power rating is 0 at the end of combat, lower your MP to level 1. You may not redirect damage to allies.) Power: Focused energy attack or prevent all damage from a physical or energy attack. Draw a card.

name: Goku, the All Powerful
Text: Physical attack doing +5 power stages or damage and 5 life cards of damage.

name: Goku, the Competitor
Text: Constant Combat Power: The first physical attack Goku performs does +1 power stages of damage for each Non-Combat card you have in play.

name: Goku, the Defender
Text: Power: Raise your anger 2 at the end of combat this turn if you've taken 5 or more life cards of damage while Goku, the Defender is in play this turn (This must be activated in your Attackers Attacks Phase and only counts life cards of damage taken on this level).

name: Goku, the Galaxy's Hero
Text: Focused physical attack doing 1 life card of damage for each Non-Combat card in play and in your discard pile. This must be the first attack you perform during Combat.

name: Goku, the Hero
Text: When entering Combat, draw a card. If that card is a Goku named card, and if Chi-Chi and Gohan are in play, draw another card.

name: Goku, the King's Pupil
Text: Once per game, you may search either your Life Deck or your discard pile for up to 5 Drills and place them into play.

name: Goku, the Leader
Text: Power: At the end of combat this turn, if you've taken no life cards of damage during this combat, you may search your Life Deck for an ally and put it into play at 3 power stages above 0, you may only use this power on your opponents turn (This must be activated in your Attackers Attacks phase).

name: Goku, the Legendary
Text: Draw 2 cards. Place the bottom 2 cards of your discard pile on the bottom of your Life Deck.

name: Goku, the Mighty
Text: Power: For the remainder of combat whenever you stop an attack with a card from the Frieza Saga, you may shuffle it back into your Life Deck after use.

name: Goku, the Perfect Warrior
Text: Physical attack doing +3 power stages of damage and 3 life cards of damage. Lower your opponent's anger 1 level.

name: Goku, the Protector
Text: Constant Combat Power: Defense Shield: Stop the first unstopped energy attack in Combat. You cannot have your anger lowered more than 1 level from any card.

name: Goku, the Proud
Text: Energy attack doing 1 life card of damage for each Non-Combat card you have in play. If you declared a Tokui-Waza raise Goku to his highest power stage.

name: Goku, the Puppet
Text: Physical attack doing +4 power stages of damage. If successful and the bottom card of your discard pile is a Goku Named card, you may draw that card into your hand.

name: Goku, the Saiyan
Text: Lower your opponent's anger 1 level. Draw the bottom card from your discard pile.

name: Goku, the Unbeatable
Text: Constant Combat Power: All your energy attacks do 2 life cards of damage when they are stopped.

name: Goku, the Warrior
Text: Constant Combat Power: When entering Combat, search your discard pile for a Non-Combat card, place it into your hand. Lower your opponent's anger 1 level.

name: Goku, Young Again
Text: Constant Combat Power: When entering Combat, search your Life Deck for a Saiyan Heritage only card and place it into your hand.

name: Gone Fishin'
Text: Tuff Enuff only. Endurance 2. End Combat. During the Discard Step of this turn, you may keep 1 additional card in your hand.

name: Good Advice
Text: Energy attack doing 8 life cards of damage. Lower opponent's anger 3 levels. Limit 1 per deck. Remove from the game after use.

name: Goten
Text: Physical attack doing +4 power stages of damage. You may remove any amount of cards in your discard pile from the game. For every 3 cards you remove in this way, you may discard a Non-Combat card or Ally in play.

name: Goten
Text: Physical attack doing +3 power stages of damage. You may remove 3 cards in your discard pile from the game to have this attack do an additional +3 life cards of damage.

name: Goten
Text: Physical attack doing +3 life cards of damage. You may remove any number of cards in your discard pile from the game to have Goten gain the same number of power stages. Lower your opponent's anger 2 levels.

name: Goten
Text: Physical attack doing 5 life cards of damage. You may remove 4 cards in your discard pile from the game to make this a focused attack, raise your anger 1 level, and lower your opponent's anger 2 levels.

name: Goten HT
Text: Physical attack doing 7 power stages of damage. You must remove the top 2 cards of your discard pile from the game to perform this attack.

name: Goten HT
Text: Physical attack doing 3 power stages of damage. If successful, all of your physical attacks do +3 power stages of damage for the remainder of Combat.

name: Goten HT
Text: Constant Combat Power: When Goten performs a Styled physical attack, you may remove 4 cards in your discard pile from the game to make it a focused attack.

name: Goten's Flying Drill
Text: When entering Combat as the defender, you may search your Life Deck for a card with the word "Flight" in the title and place it into your hand.

name: Goten's Focused Blast
Text: Focused energy attack doing 8 life cards of damage. You can only perform this attack if you have no cards in your discard pile.

name: Goten, Family Kamehameha
Text: (If this card is part of your MP Stack, your cards with "Kamehameha" in the title are considered non-styled for Tokui-Waza requirements for the remainder of the game) Constant Combat Power: Your cards with "Kamehameha" in the title are also considered Goten named cards for card effects. You may pay life cards instead of power stages when paying costs to perform energy attacks.

name: Goten, the Brother
Text: Physical attack doing 5 life cards of damage. If successful, raise your anger 1 level. If you did not declare a Tokui-Waza, you may use this power twice per Combat.

name: Goten, the Playful
Text: Physical attack doing 5 power stages of damage. If stopped, raise Goten to his highest power stage.

name: Goten, the Young Saiyan
Text: Energy attack doing 5 life cards of damage. Remove 2 cards in your discard pile from the game. If successful, draw the bottom 2 cards of your discard pile.

name: Gotenk's Head Butt
Text: Physical attack doing +3 power stages of damage. If successful, prevent 3 power stages of damage from attacks performed against you for the remainder of Combat.

name: Gotenks
Text: Physical attack doing 7 power stages of damage. This power may be used twice per Combat. When you perform this attack, you may discard a card in your hand to make this a focused attack.

name: Gotenks' Double Lethal Missile
Text: Energy attack doing 4 life cards of damage. If Gotenks is in play, you may discard all cards under your Warrior Sword. If used by Gotenks, this attack stays on the table to be used one more time this combat. Remove from game after use.

name: Gotenks' Fast Action
Text: Fused characters only. Physical attack doing +3 power stages of damage. Lower your opponent's anger 1 level. Gain 2 power stages. This attack stays on the table to be used 1 more time this Combat.

name: Gotenks' Flight
Text: Physical attack doing 6 power stages of damage. If used by a Fused Personality, this is a focused attack doing an additional +4 power stages of damage and lowers your opponent's anger to 0.

name: Gotenks' Kamikaze Ghost
Text: (You can have up to 6 copies of this card in your Life Deck.) Gotenks only. Place this card in play. While this card is in play, you may remove it from the game during your "Attacker Attacks" phase to discard the top 6 cards of your opponent's Life Deck.

name: Gotenks' Potential
Text: If your Main Personality is a fused personality, shuffle 7 cards in your discard pile into your Life Deck. Remove from the game after use.

name: Gotenks, Super Saiyan
Text: Energy attack doing 8 life cards of damage. Costs 0 power stages to perform. This power may be used twice per Combat. When you perform this attack, you may discard a card in your hand to make this a focused attack.

name: Gotenks, Super Saiyan 3
Text: Physical attack doing +7 power stages of damage. Lower your opponent's anger to 0. Gain 5 power stages. Place the bottom 3 cards of your discard pile at the bottom of your Life Deck. This power may be used a second time this Combat.

name: Grabbing the Tail
Text: Reduce the foe's power level by 4 stages, or to 0, whichever happens first. Discard this card from the game after use.

name: Grand Kai
Text: Constant Combat Power: All your attacks do +1 power stages of damage. Grand Kai does not need to take control of Combat to use this power.

name: Grand Kai Sensei
Text: Once per Combat, you may prevent 2 power stages of damage from an attack.

name: Grand Kai's Palace
Text: When one of your Celestial Fighters stops an attack with a card that removes itself from the game after use, you may place that card at the bottom of your Life Deck instead of removing it from the game.

name: Grappling Stance
Text: All of your physical attacks do +2 power stages of damage for the remainder of Combat.

name: Gravity Chamber
Text: All physical attacks cost +2 power stages to perform.

name: Great Ape, Oozaru #1
Text: (This card may only be played from your Sensei Deck.) Energy attack doing 8 life cards of damage and costs 3 power stages to perform. If King Vegeta is your main personality, this power may be used a second time this combat.

name: Great Ape, Oozaru #2
Text: Physical attack doing +5 power stages of damage. If successful, discard up to 1 ally or non-combat card in play.

name: Gregory
Text: (If King Kai is your MP, Gregory gains Resist.) Constant Combat Power: Gregory does not need to be in control of combat to use this power: Your personality powers that perform attacks are focused.

name: Group Attack
Text: Energy attack doing 5 life cards of damage. Must be performed by an Ally that has not performed this attack this Combat. This card stays on the table to be used 2 more times this Combat. Remove from the game after use.

name: Guldo
Text: Physical Attack. If successful, you also may take the 2 bottom cards from your discard pile into your hand.

name: Guldo
Text: Energy Attack. This attack cannot be stopped by using combat card defenses.

name: Guldo
Text: Physical Attack. This attack cannot be stopped by using combat card defenses.

name: Guldo's Time Freeze Drill
Text: Villains only. Reduce the damage from all attacks performed against you by 1 power stage or 1 life card of damage.

name: Guru as your Ally
Text: Remove all copies of "Guru Fades" in all player's Life Decks and discard piles from the game.

name: Guru Fades
Text: Remove all Namek Dragon Balls in play and in all Life Decks from the game.

name: Guru, Elder Namekian
Text: Constant Combat Power: Your allies gain +1 power stage during the power-up step. If Nail or Dende are in play, you may play allies 1 level higher than your main personality's level. You may use this power regardless of your MP's power rating.

name: Half-Nelson
Text: Physical attack doing +2 power stages of damage. If successful, attach to your opponent's Main Personality. While this card is attached, the owner of Half-Nelson may discard a card from his hand during his "Attacker Attacks" phase to make the attached personality discard the top 2 cards of his Life Deck.

name: Hatchiyack's Android Assault
Text: Physical attack doing +5 power stages of damage. If in either your last Attacker Attacks phase or Defender Defends phase, you used a card with Android in the title you may raise your anger 2 levels or gain 5 power stages.

name: Hatchiyack, Android Activated
Text: In your next Attacker Attacks phase perform a physical attack doing +5 power stages of damage. If your opponent's MP is Saiyan Heritage this attack doing 10 power stages of damage instead. Raise your anger 1 level.

name: Hatchiyack, Android Anger
Text: In your next Attacker Attacks phase perform an energy attack doing 10 life cards of damage or pass. If your opponent's MP is Saiyan Heritage this attack costs 0 power stages to perform.

name: Hatchiyack, Android Archive
Text: Constant Combat Power: At the end of the discard step, if you have no cards in your hand you may draw a card. The first time you pass each combat, gain 2 anger. If your opponent is Saiyan Heritage gain 3 anger instead.

name: Hatchiyack, Android Assault
Text: In your next Attacker Attacks phase perform a physical attack doing +5 power stages of damage. In your following Attacker Attacks phase this combat, peform an energy attack doing 10 life cards of damage or pass. If your opponent's MP is Saiyan Heritage, this attack costs 0 power stages to perform.

name: He's Safe
Text: Gain 5 power stages. Choose 2 cards from your discard pile and shuffle them into your Life Deck.

name: Head to Head Action
Text: League and Tuff Enuff only. Physical attack doing +4 power stages of damage. For the remainder of Combat, any player may discard a card from his hand to perform a physical attack doing +2 power stages of damage or an energy attack costing 2 power stages to perform.

name: Healing Magic
Text: Use during your Non-Combat Step. Place one of your level 1 Allies in your discard pile into play at his highest power stage to place the bottom 3 cards of your discard pile at the bottom of your Life Deck.

name: Hercule
Text: Constant Combat Power: Hercule may use "Villains only" cards. During your "Attacker Attacks" phase, you may discard a card from your hand to make your opponent discard the top 3 cards of his Life Deck.

name: Hercule Draws Steel
Text: Endurance 3. Physical attack doing 4 power stages of damage. Shuffle any "Hercule Draws Steel" cards in your discard pile into your Life Deck.

name: Hercule's Amazing Techniques
Text: Search your Sensei Deck for a card that performs an attack and play it during this "Attacker Attacks" phase. Remove from the game after use. Limit 2 per deck.

name: Hercule's Assault Drill
Text: All of your attacks do +1 life cards of damage and gain "If successful, the personality that performed this attack gains 1 power stage."

name: Hercule's Close Save
Text: Use when your opponent would win by the Survivial Victory. Shuffle the top 4 cards of your discard pile into your Life Deck. Using this card prevents the Survival Victory but cannot be used in Tuff Enuff. Limit 1 per deck. Remove from the game after use.

name: Hercule's Dream Sequence
Text: Stops a physical or energy attack. For the remainder of Combat during your "Defender Defends" phase, if your opponent's Main Personality has a power rating 3 or more times higher than your Main Personality's, stops a physical or energy attack in that phase. Remove from the game after use. Limit 2 per deck.

name: Hercule's Drop Kick
Text: Physical attack doing +6 power stages of damage. If stopped, gain 3 power stages and place this card at the bottom of your Life Deck. Unless your Main Personality is Hercule, limit 1 per deck.

name: Hercule's Immunity
Text: Sensei Deck. Hercule only. For the remainder of Combat, Majin Buu cannot perform attacks while your Hercule is in control of Combat as your Ally or Main Personality. Remove from the game after use.

name: Hercule's Megaton Punch
Text: (If your opponent would use a card effect that discards a card from your hand or shuffles them into your life deck, you may discard this card to stop that effect and use this card's secondary effects.) Physical attack doing 6 power stages of damage. Until the end of the turn, any cards in your hand, discard pile, or life deck cannot be discarded, removed, or put into your life deck by your opponent's non-damage card effects.

name: Hercule's Nibble
Text: Leauge and Tuff Enuff only. Your opponent discards the top 2 cards of his Life Deck. Shuffle your Life Deck after use.

name: Hercule's Power Stance
Text: Physical attack doing +1 power stages of damage. For the remainder of Combat, when a Drill or Combat card increases the power stages or life cards of damage for any of your attacks, raise that amount by 1. Unless your Main Personality is Hercule, limit 1 per deck.

name: Hercule's Realization
Text: Use when entering Combat. Instead of Drawing 3 cards from your Life Deck during your "Defende Draws 3 Cards" phase, you may search your Life Deck and discard pile for up to 3 Allies and place them into play at their highest power stages. The allies you place into play with this power may be one level higher than your Main Personality's current personality level.

name: Hercule's Smackdown
Text: Tuff Enuff only. Villains only. Physical attack doing +4 power stages of damage. If successful, or used by Hercule, shuffle up to 5 Tuff Enuff only cards in your discard pile into your life deck. Remove from the game after use.

name: Hercule's Underground Training Arena
Text: During your Rejuvenation Step, you may place one of the bottom 5 cards of your discard pile on the top of your Life Deck.

name: Hercule, the Everlasting World Champ
Text: Constant Combat Power: (If this is your Main Personality's level 1, then at the beginning of the game name a personality. All of that personality's Named Cards are also considered Hercule Named Cards for the remainder of the game) Hercule can play and use "Villains only" cards.

name: Hercule, the Puppet
Text: Constant Combat Power: Hercule may play and use "Villains only" cards.

name: Hercule, the World Champion
Text: Constant Combat Power: Hercule may use Villains only cards. Once per Combat during your "Attacker Attacks" phase, you may discard the top card of your Life Deck to have Hercule perform a focused physical attack doing 7 power stages of damage.

name: Hercule, Unstoppable?
Text: (If this card is in your MP stack, cards with "Smackdown" in the title do not count against your tokui-waza.) Constant Combat Power: Hercule can play and use "Villains only" cards. Attacks you perform with Tuff Enuff Only cards deal +3 power stages of damage.

name: Hercule-Goku
Text: Constant Combat Power: You may use "Villains only" cards. Prevent 2 power stages and 1 life card of damage from all attacks performed against you.

name: Hero Advantage
Text: Heroes only. Use when entering Combat as the defender. Instead of drawing 3 cards from your life deck, draw the top 3 cards from your discard pile. If there are not enough cards in the discard pile, this card cannot be used. Remove from the game after use.

name: Hero Enraged!
Text: Heroes only. Raise your anger 2 levels. Take any 2 cards from your discard pile and place them at the bottom of your life deck. Remove from the game after use. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Hero Teamwork Drill
Text: Heroes only. Opponent's can play only 1 dragon ball on their turn.

name: Hero's Drill
Text: Sensei Deck only. All attacks performed against a Majin do +1 power stages of damage. All successful physical attacks you perform remove the bottom card of your opponent's Life Deck from the game before damage is dealt. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Hero's Lucky Break
Text: Name a Non-Combat/non-Dragon Ball card. Search your Life Deck for a copy of that card and put it into play. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Hero's Way
Text: At the beginning of each player's next turn, that player searches his discard pile for all allies and puts them into his hand.

name: Heroes En Masse
Text: The next attack you perform does +X power stages of damage. One of your personalities in play gains X power stages. X = number of Allies you have in play. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Heroes' Battleground
Text: All attacks performed by Allies do +2 power stages of damage.

name: Heroes' Discovery
Text: Look at your opponent's hand. If your opponent's Main Personality has "Android" in the card title, choose and discard a card from his hand.

name: Heroic Block
Text: Sensei Deck. Stops a physical attack or energy attack performed by a Majin. This card can stop focused attacks performed by Majins. Remove from the game after use.

name: Heroic Charge
Text: Sensei Deck. Physical attack doing +4 power stages of damage. If performed against a Majin, choose a card in your hand that can perform an attack or stop an attack and place it into play. That card is now a Non-Combat card instead of its normal type until it leaves play.

name: Heroic Deeds
Text: (You cannot name or affect a Main Personality, Dragon Ball, Sensei, or Mastery with this card.) Heroes Only. Energy attack. You may shuffle a card in play into its owner's life deck.

name: Heroic Double Team
Text: Heroes only. Choose one of your Allies in play. If you chose an Ally draw a card. For the remainder of Combat, the chosen Ally may take control of Combat even if your Main Personality is 2 power stages above 0 or higher.

name: Heroic Drill
Text: Heroes only. When entering Combat, as the active player, you may search your Life Deck for a "Heroes only" card and place it into your hand. You can only have 1 "Heroic Drill" in play at a time.

name: Heroic Effort
Text: Heroes only. Energy attack doing 6 life cards of damage. If performed against a villain, this attack is focused, gain 2 power stages, and for the remainder of Combat, your opponent cannot have Allies take control of Combat.

name: Heroic Final Strike
Text: Sensei Deck. Heroes only. Physical attack doing +2 power stages and +2 life cards of damage. If this attack is performed against a Villain, it does +4 power stages and +4 life cards of damage instead.

name: Heroic Force
Text: Sensei Deck. Heroes only. Physical attack doing +3 power stages of damage. If performed against Vegeta, Frieza, King Cold, Android 20, Cell, Majin Babidi, or Majin Buu, this is a focused attack and does an additional +3 life cards of damage.

name: Heroic Head Kick
Text: Sensei Deck. Heroes only. Physical attack doing +3 life cards of damage. If your opponent's Main Personality is a Majin, stops the next physical or energy attack performed against you this Combat.

name: Heroic Head Throw
Text: Sensei Deck. Heroes only. Physical attack doing +3 power stages of damage. If performed against a Majin, this attack doing +6 power stages of damage instead and stops the next focused attack your opponent performs this Combat. Raise your anger 1 level.

name: Heroic Kamehameha
Text: Heroes only. Energy attack. Empower 3. If your opponent's Main Personality is a Majin and he is at level 2 or above, lower your opponent's Main Personality 1 level.

name: Heroic Power Detonation
Text: Heroes only. Focused energy attack doing 7 life cards of damage. If successful and performed against a Villain, you may either discard 3 of his Non-Combat cards in play or have his Main Personality lose 4 power stages.

name: Heroic Power Shot
Text: Heroes only. Focused energy attack doing +1 life cards of damage for each card in your discard pile with "Heroic" in the title. If your opponent's Main Personality is a Villain, you may discard a Non-Combat card in play.

name: Heroic Quick Kick
Text: Sensei Deck. Heroes only. Physical attack doing +4 power stages of damage. If your opponent's Main Personality is a Majin, damage from this attack cannot be prevented and discard one of your opponent's Non-Combat, Ally, or Battleground cards in play.

name: Heroic Shoulder Slam
Text: Sensei Deck. Heroes only. Physical attack doing +4 life cards of damage. If performed against a Majin, your opponent discards the top 3 cards of his Life Deck.

name: Heroic Sword Catch
Text: Heroes only. Stops a physical attack. You may remove any amount of cards in your discard pile with the word "Sword" in the title from the game. The next attack you perform this Combat that is not unstoppable or focused does +1 life cards of damage for every card removed this way.

name: Hidden Power Level
Text: Physical attack. Raise your Main Personality to his highest power stage.

name: Hideous Intent
Text: Place the bottom 3 cards of your discard pile at the bottom of your Life Deck. For the remainder of Combat, when your opponent passes he must discard a card from his hand. Remove from the game after use.

name: Hirudegarn's Teleportation

Physical attack doing +4 stages of damage. If successful, discard the top 2 cards of your opponent's Life Deck.

name: Hirudegarn, Dormant
Text: (If this card is in your Main Personality stack, you cannot win by MPPV.) Constant Combat Power: Each time your opponent performs an attack, raise your anger 1 level.

name: Hirudegarn, Fulfilled

name: Hirudegarn, Transformed
Text: (When you gain anger, if your anger isn't 0, your MP loses 3 power stages to a mimimum of 0. Attacks performed against Hirudegarn gain "If successful, raise your opponent's anger 1 level.") Raise your MP to its highest power stage. Discard the top 4 cards of your opponent's Life Deck. For the remainder of combat, your successful attacks gain "Discard the top 2 cards of your opponent's Life Deck."

name: Hirudegarn, Unleashed

Physical attack doing +X life cards of damage, where X= the amount of cards your opponent has discarded from the top of their Life Deck this combat. Discard the top 3 cards of your opponent's Life Deck.

name: Homework Time ...
Text: Name a non-Dragon Ball card. Look through the top 5 cards of your Life Deck for it. If it is there, show it to your opponent and set the 5 cards aside in the order they were in to shuffle any 5 cards in your discard pile into your Life Deck. Now place the 5 cards on top of your Life Deck.

name: Horrified
Text: Sensei Deck. Set all Allies in play to 0. Remove from the game after use.

name: Huge Drill
Text: All of your physical attacks do +1 power stages of damage. Attacks that cannot be stopped can be stopped while this Drill is in play.

name: Huge Strength Maneuver
Text: League and Tuff Enuff only. Physical attack doing +3 power stages of damage for every 4 power stages this personality is above 0. Raise your anger 1 level. If damage from this attack is redirected to an Ally, the power stages of damage become life cards of damage instead.

name: HUH???
Text: Sensei Deck Only. Remove a Dragon Ball in play from the game. Limit 1 per deck. Remove from the game after use.

name: Human Extinction Attack
Text: Endurance 2. Energy attack doing 8 life cards of damage. Costs 5 power stages to perform. If successful and used by Majin Buu, remove from the game all Allies in play and in all Life Decks.

name: Human Technology
Text: Heroes only. This card stops the combat. Remove from the game after use.

name: Hybis Sensei
Text: (You cannot gain anger, nor modify the amount of anger gained, via the effects of your Mastery card, or win by MPPV.) Once per combat, during your Attacker Attacks phase, raise your anger 2 levels.

name: Hyperbolic Time Chamber
Text: All physical attacks do +1 power stage of damage. All energy attacks do +1 life card of damage.

name: I Didn't Want This
Text: Use this card after you take Life Cards of damage. Shuffle the discarded cards back into your Life Deck, and discard the same amount of cards.

name: I Want You!
Text: League only. Use at the beginning of your opponent's Power Up Step. Your opponent cannot skip the Combat Step of this turn, even if another card effect would make them skip Combat or if they played a battleground or location. Limit 1 per deck. Remove from the game after use.

name: I'm a Popo in a Bottle...
Text: League only. Attach this card to an Ally in play. Until this card is now longer attached to this Ally, he cannot take control of Combat, and cannot have damage redirected to him. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Icarus
Text: If Gohan is your Main Personality, draw a card and raise your anger 1 level.

name: Impressive Power
Text: Your Main Personality gains 5 power stages. For the remainder of Combat, whenever your Main Personality performs a styled physical attack, you may pay 3 power stages to make it a focused attack.

name: In The Groove
Text: You must have performed 2 successful physical attacks in this Combat to use this card. Raise your anger 2 levels.

name: Ingrain in the Membrane
Text: Attach to one of your Non-Combat cards in play that is not "Orange Focusing Drill." While attached, when another card effect would discard or remove from the game the attached Non-Combat card, this card is discarded or removed instead.

name: Initiative
Text: When entering Combat as the defender, you may remove this card from the game to make your opponent skip his first "Attacker Attacks" phase of that Combat. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Injured
Text: Attach this card to a personality after you perform a successful physical attack. All attacks performed by this personality do -2 power stags and -2 life cards of damage. Discard this card when this personality is at its highest power stage.

name: Injured Circuits
Text: Shuffle all cards in your hand back into your Life Deck and draw the same amount of cards. Draw a card. If you have at least 3 personalities in play with "Android" in the title, you may draw an additional card. Remove from the game after use. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Intense Observation Drill
Text: All PUR's gain +2. It takes only 1 life card of damage to capture a Dragon Ball instead of 5. This effect overwrites any effect that changes the life cards of damage needed to capture a Dragon Ball. You can only have 1 copy of this Drill in play at a time.

name: Intensity Drill
Text: When one of your attacks deals 5 or more life cards of damage, place the bottom card of your discard pile under this Drill. If there are 3 or more cards under this Drill, during your "Attacker Attacks" phase you may discard this Drill. If you do, you cannot win by the Most Powerful Personality Victory, and you may advance or lower your MP to any level.

name: Interesting Information
Text: For the remainder of the game at the beginning of each Step, the top card of every Life Deck must be turned faceup if it is facedown. Remove from the game after use.

name: Interview with the Green Guy
Text: For the remainder of Combat, your attacks do +2 power stages of damage for each personality in play. If your Main Personality is Saibaimen, then for the remainder of Combat, all of your energy attacks from Saiyan Saga, Frieza Saga, and Trunks Saga are focused attacks. Remove from the game after use.

name: It's All About Time
Text: Use when needed. When your opponent reaches 5 or more anger, set his anger and power stages to 0. Limit 1 per deck.

name: It's Empty?
Text: Search your Life Deck for a level 1 Ally and place it into play facedown. You may ignore the Ally uniqueness rule for this Ally. When you redirect damage from an attack to this Ally, or when you have this Ally take control of Combat, you turn this Ally faceup and set him at his highest power stage.

name: It's Just Not Worth It!
Text: Your opponent may not win a Most Powerful Personality Victory or a Dragon Ball Victory until the end of his second turn, starting now. Limit 1 per deck. Remove from the game after use.

name: Janemba

name: Jeice, the Avenger

name: Jeice, the Brash

If you do, shuffle it into its owner's life deck and you may not play copies of that Dragon Ball for the remainder of combat. If "Kami's Floating Island" is not in play, search your life deck or discard pile for a copy and place it into play instead.

Text: Physical attack doing 10 power stages of damage. If successful, shuffle the bottom 3 cards of your discard pile back into your Life Deck. If stopped, discard the top 3 cards of your Life Deck.

name: Maraikoh, the Strong
Text: Physical attack doing 9 power stages of damage. If successful, discard an Ally in play. If stopped, discard the top 3 cards of your Life Deck.

name: Maraikoh, the Vicious
Text: Energy attack doing 7 life cards of damage. If stopped, discard the top 3 cards of your Life Deck.

name: Marba Sensei
Text: Twice per game, during your Attacker Attacks phase, you may remove up to 5 cards from any player's discard pile, divided as you choose, from the game.

name: March of the Great Apes
Text: Attach a "Great Ape, Oozaru" you control to your opponent's main personality. While attached, it's text box is considered to say "When entering combat, discard one of your non-combat cards, battlegrounds or locations. If you cannot, discard the top 2 cards of your life deck. Discard this card when your MP's power level reaches 0."

name: Massacre of the Billions and Millions of Bountiful Mini Bitty Maliciously Baneful Majin Buus
Text: Discard all cards in your hand. For the remainder of Combat, all attacks performed by your Allies are focused attacks. For the remainder of Combat, if your opponent stops an attack performed by a Majin Personality, he must discard the top card of his Life Deck. Remove from the game after use.

name: Massive Technology
Text: Endurance 2. For the remainder of Combat, all of your physical attacks do +2 power stages of damage. If used by a personality with "Android" in the card title, all of your attacks deal +2 life cards of damage instead.

name: Master Roshi
Text: Physical attack doing 3 life cards of damage. For the remainder of Combat, all attacks your Allies perform do an additional +1 power stages and +1 life cards of damage.

name: Master Roshi
Text: Power: When entering Combat, look at the top 6 cards of your Life Deck and place them back in any order, and if you declared a Red Tokui-Waza, raise your anger 2 levels.

name: Master Roshi
Text: Constant Combat Power: Any named cards that perform attacks do +2 power stages of damage. If you declared a Red Tokui-Waza, they do +3 power stages of damage instead.

name: Master Roshi
Text: Constant Combat Power: All of your Allies power up one extra stage during your Power Up Step. If you declared a Red Tokui-Waza, they power up 2 extra stages instead, and any attacks they perform do +1 life card of damage.

name: Master Roshi Sensei
Text: All of your attacks do +1 life cards of damage. All of your opponent's attacks do -1 life cards of damage.

name: Master Roshi's Back Kick
Text: Physical attack doing +3 power stages of damage. Discard one of your opponent's Allies in play. For each Ally in your opponent's discard pile, your opponent discards the top card of his Life Deck. Remove from the game after use.

name: Master Roshi's Gawking Drill
Text: All of your attacks do +1 power stages of damage. When you perform an attack, remove a card in your opponent's discard pile from the game.

name: Master Roshi's Island
Text: All named cards cost +2 life cards to play.

name: Master Roshi's Makeshift Background
Text: Search your Life Deck for a Battleground or Location that is not in play and place it in play. When Combat ends shuffle that Battleground or Location back into your Life Deck. This effect does not remove any Battleground or Location in play.

name: Master Roshi's Scouting Drill
Text: If your Main Personality's current personality level is from the Saiyan Saga, any attacks from your Main Personality's power are unstoppable. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Masterful Moves

name: Mean Squeeze

name: Medic Kit

name: Meditation Drill
Text: When entering Combat, you may shuffle your Life Deck or discard pile.

name: Megaton Bull Crusher
Text: Physical attack doing +1 power stages of damage for each Common card in your discard pile to a maximum of +10 power stages.

name: Meta-Cooler
Text: Constant Combat Power: When a Drill or Combat card increases the power stages or life cards of damage for any of your attacks, raise that increase by 1. If the top card of your discard pile is a Blue Style card, your Drills cannot leave play because of your opponent's card effects.

name: Meta-Cooler
Text: Constant Combat Power: When a Drill that you have in play increase the power stages or life cards of damage from any of your attacks, raise that increase by 2. When you perform a physical attack and the top card of your discard pile is a Blue Style card, gain 3 power stages.

name: Meta-Cooler
Text: Constant Combat Power: When a Drill that you have in play increase the power stages or life cards of damage from any of your attacks, raise that increase by 3. When performing a physical attack with a Blue Style card and the top card of your discard pile is a Blue Style card, it's a focused attack doing +3 life cards of damage.

name: Meta-Cooler Clone
Text: (If your MP is Meta-Cooler, you may include up to 6 copies of this card in your deck.) Power: Stops a physical attack, or you may discard this card from play to search your discard pile for a drill and put it into play.

name: Mighty Mask
Text: Physical attack doing +3 power stages of damage. If the top card of your discard pile is a Red Style card, this is a focused attack, raise your anger 1 level, and Mighty Mask gains 4 power stages.

name: Mighty Mask
Text: Constant Combat Power: All of your physical attack do +2 power stages of damage. When the top card of your discard pile is a Red Style card, all of your attacks do an additional +2 life cards of damage.

name: Mighty Mask
Text: Constant Combat Power: The first Red Style physical attack you perform each Combat is a focused attack. Once per Combat, whenever you stop an attack from your hand with a Red Style card, you may shuffle that Red Style card back into your Life Deck after use, even if it would remove itself from the game.

name: Mind Control Device
Text: Attach this card to a Main Personality. While attached, when a card effect would raise his anger, that amount is reduced by 1 before modifiers unless he has used "Goku's Farewell." Only 1 "Mind Control Device" may be attached to this Personality at a time.

name: Momentum
Text: If you are the 2nd player to pass when both players pass consecutively, you may remove this card from the game. If you do and your opponent's turn is next, skip that turn and you cannot play Non-Combat cards during your next turn.

name: Mommy's Coming Dear

name: Mother's Touch
Text: Stops a physical or energy attack. Remove from the game after use.

name: Motherly Rage

name: Mr. Popo

name: Mr. Popo
Text: Constant Combat Power: The first styled attack you perform during Combat gains, "If successful, your opponent discards a card from his hand." If your opponent did not declare a Tokui-Waza or declared a Freestyle Tokui-Waza, all attacks you perform gain this effect.

name: Mr. Popo
Text: This personality gains 3 power stages. This card can affect Dragon Balls. Choose 1 card at random from your opponent's hand and remove it from the game.

name: Mr. Popo's Calming

name: Multi-form Training

name: Multi-Purpose Strike

name: Nagging Drill

name: Nail Combat Drill

name: Nail Inspired

name: Nail Takes Extra Effort

name: Nail the Namekian
Text: Energy attack doing 5 life cards of damage. If this attack is stopped, your opponent discards 3 life cards.

name: Nail the Namekian Hero

name: Nail, At All Costs
Text: (Piccolo is considered to be in play for card effects.) Power: Physical attack doing 3 life cards of damage. For the remainder of combat, physical attacks performed by Nail that do not use the Physical Attack table do +3 power stages and +1 life card of damage.

name: Namek Dragon Ball 1
Text: Draw cards until you have 3 cards in your hand. Place the top 2 cards in your discard pile at the bottom of your Life Deck.

name: Namek Dragon Ball 2
Text: Choose an opponent and reduce his Main Personality 1 personality level if possible.

name: Namek Dragon Ball 3
Text: Draw up to 3 cards from the bottom of your discard pile into your hand.

name: Namek Dragon Ball 4
Text: Discard all opponents' Non-Combat/non-Dragon Ball cards in play.

name: Namek Dragon Ball 5
Text: Raise your Main Personality to his highest power stage. Raise your anger 1 level. Place the top 2 cards of your discard pile at the bottom of your Life Deck.

name: Namek Dragon Ball 6
Text: Raise your anger 2 levels or lower an opponent's anger 2 levels.

name: Namek Dragon Ball 7
Text: Capture any other Dragon Ball.

name: Namek Dragon Ball Combat

name: Namek Dragon Ball Wish
Text: Ends a Combat. Choose any 3 cards from your discard pile and shuffle them back into your Life Deck. Remove from the game after use. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Namekian Absorption
Text: Namekian Heritage Only. If you declared a Tokui-Waza, you may discard an Ally in play to advance a personality level. You cannot win by MPPV for the remainder of the game.

name: Namekian Blocking Defense
Text: Namekian Heritage only. You may have up to 8 copies of this card in your Life Deck. Stops a physical attack.

name: Namekian Blocking Stance

Remove from the game after use.

name: Namekian Combo

name: Namekian Crash

If you have shuffled cards back into your life deck earlier this combat, you may place 1 of the chosen cards into your hand. Remove from the game after use.

name: Namekian Crushing Blow

name: Namekian Crushing Hold

name: Namekian Dash

name: Namekian Dash Attack

name: Namekian Defensive Stance

name: Namekian Destruction Blast

The chosen Dragonball loses its power until the end of the turn. If you have 1 or more Dragonballs in play, instead you may shuffle a Dragonball you control back into its owner's life deck and search for a different Dragonball and place it into play. As long as you control 1 or more Dragonballs, you cannot end combat.

You may shuffle a Dragonball you control back into its owner's life deck to search your life deck for a card with "8" in the power box other than "Namekian Dragon Punch" and put it into your hand. Remove from the game after use.
