If successful and you declared a tokui-waza, gain 2 power stages and shuffle the top card of your discard pile back into your life deck. You may have up to 8 copies of this card in your deck.

name: Namekian Ducking Technique
Text: Stops a physical attack. If you declared a Tokui-Waza raise your Main Personality to its highest power stage and place the bottom card of your discard pile at the bottom of your Life Deck.

name: Namekian Elbow Strike

name: Namekian Energy Absorption

name: Namekian Energy Beam
Text: Energy attack doing 10 life cards of damage. Costs 4 power stages to perform. If successful, remove the top 3 cards of your Life Deck from the game. If this attack is stopped, discard your hand. Remove from the game after use.

name: Namekian Energy Catch
Text: Stops an energy attack. Gain 3 power stages.

name: Namekian Energy Deflection
Text: Namekian Heritage only. Stops an energy attack. Shuffle the top and bottom cards from your discard pile into your Life Deck.

name: Namekian Energy Drill
Text: After every successful energy attack you perform, you may discard a card from your hand and shuffle it into your Life Deck, and then draw a card.

name: Namekian Energy Focus
Text: Draw the bottom card from your discard pile. If that card is a Namekian Style card, you may search your Life Deck for an Energy Combat card and place it in your hand. Remove from the game after use. Limit 1 per deck.

name: Namekian Energy Ray

name: Namekian Fearless Chop

name: Namekian Fighting
Text: Namekian Heritage only. Remove one of your allies from the game to raise your anger 2 levels. Remove from the game after use.

name: Namekian Final Flash
Text: Energy attack doing 5 life cards of damage. Costs 1 power stage to perform. If successful, shuffle the top card of your discard pile back into your Life Deck.

name: Namekian Finger Blast

For the remainder of Combat, when you use Endurance your Main Personality gains an amount of power stages equal to the damage actually prevented after damage is dealt. Limit 2 per deck. Remove from the game after use.

name: Namekian Finishing Effort
Text: (You may place this card into play from your hand after taking damage from one of your opponents attacks.) Your opponent discards the top 3 cards from his Life Deck.

name: Namekian Fist Block

name: Namekian Fist Dodge
Text: Endurance 3. Namekian Heritage only. Physical attack, or stops a physical attack.

name: Namekian Fist Smash
Text: Physical attack doing +3 power stages of damage. If you declared a Tokui-Waza, for every life card of damage this attack deals, choose a card from your discard pile and place it on the bottom of your Life Deck. Remove from the game after use.

name: Namekian Flight

name: Namekian Flying Kick

name: Namekian Focused Blast

name: Namekian Focused Jab
Text: Physical attack doing +4 power stages of damage. If you declared a Tokui-Waza, this attack is a focused physical attack. If successful, gain 3 power stages.

name: Namekian Focused Kick
Text: Physical attack doing +5 power stages of damage. Gain 4 power stages. If performed against a Majin, this attack is a focused physical attack.

name: Namekian Focusing Effort
Text: Namekian Heritage only. Raise your Main Personality to its highest power stage. Choose up to 3 cards in your discard pile and shuffle them into your Life Deck.

name: Namekian Foot Lunge
Text: Endurance 4. Physical attack doing +2 power stages of damage. If successful, choose a card in your discard pile and shuffle it back into your Life Deck.

name: Namekian Forearm Smash
Text: Physical attack doing 6 life cards of damage. Costs 3 power stages to perform. If you declared Tokui-Waza, place the top card from your discard pile at the bottom of your Life Deck.

name: Namekian Foresight
Text: Stops a physical or energy attack. Look at the top 5 cards of your life deck or discard pile. You may place them on the top and/or bottom of your life deck or discard pile, respectively, in any order. Remove from the game after use.

name: Namekian Friendship
Text: You must have an Ally in play to use this card. Discard all of your opponents' Non-Combat cards in play. Limit 1 per deck. Remove from the game after use.

name: Namekian Frustration Drill
Text: Resist. Once per combat, after taking damage from an attack, shuffle the top 2 cards of your discard pile into your life deck and gain 3 power stages. You do not have to remove your Namekian style cards from the game when you use their endurance.

name: Namekian Fusion
Text: Raise your Main Personality to its highest power stage. Draw a card and show it to your opponent. If that card is a Namekian Style card, choose 2 cards from your discard pile and place them on the bottom of your Life Deck. Remove from the game after use.

name: Namekian Gambit
Text: Use when entering Combat. Reveal your hand to your opponent. If at least 3 cards in your hand are Namekian Style cards, attach this card to your Main Personality. While attached, you may place the top 3 cards of your discard pile at the bottom of your Life Deck instead of 1 during the Rejuvenation Step.

name: Namekian Glare Attack

name: Namekian Gut Shot

name: Namekian Halting Stance
Text: Stops a physical attack. If you declared a Tokui-Waza, shuffle this card back into your Life Deck.

name: Namekian Head Strike

name: Namekian Headbutt
Text: Namekian Heritage only. Physical attack doing 3 life cards of damage. You may have up to 8 copies of this card in your Life Deck.

name: Namekian Healing
Text: Attach this card to your Cell Saga Namekian Style Mastery. When you use your Mastery while this card is attached, you may shuffle the bottom card of your discard pile into your Life Deck. You may have only 1 copy of Namekian Healing attached.

name: Namekian Heat Seeking Blast

name: Namekian Ki Volley

name: Namekian Knee Strike
Text: Sensei Deck. Physical attack doing 1 life card of damage. If successful and you declared a Tokui-Waza, discard all of your opponent's Allies in play.

name: Namekian Knowledge Drill

name: Namekian Light Jab

name: Namekian Mouth Wave

name: Namekian Offense

Text: Stops a physical attack. Lower your opponent's anger 1 level.

name: Namekian Piccolo's Fusion Training
Text: Search your life deck for an ally and a card with "Fuse" or "Fused" in the text box and place each of them into either your hand or into play. For the remainder of combat, your fused allies can take control of combat regardless of your MP's stages above 0.

name: Namekian Piccolo's Hellzone Grenade
Text: Energy attack doing 3 life cards of damage. Costs 1 power stage to perform. This attack does +1 life cards of damage for each energy attack you've performed this combat. You may remove a copy of Namekian Piccolo's Hellzone Grenade in your discard pile from the game to have this card stay on the table to be used 1 more time this combat.

name: Namekian Piccolo's Telepathy
Text: Search your life deck for a level 1 ally and place it into play at 5 power stages above 0. If you have no allies in play when you use this card, you may search for an additional level 1 ally and place it into play at 5 power stages above 0. If you declared a tokui-waza, you may end combat. Remove from the game after use.

name: Namekian Piercing Beam
Text: Endurance 2. Energy attack. If successful, discard one of your opponent's Allies in play. Lower your opponent's anger 1 level.

name: Namekian Pikkon's Defense
Text: Stops a physical or energy attack. Remove from the game after use.

name: Namekian Pointed Blast

If your Main Personalities highest power rating is below 500,000, this attack deals 6 life cards of damage and discards up to 2 Non-Combat cards in play instead. Remove from game after use.

name: Namekian Power Kick

name: Namekian Precise Aim Drill
Text: You may discard a card in your hand that can perform an energy attack to stop an energy attack. Raise your Main Personality's PUR by +2 while this Drill is in play.

name: Namekian Preparation Drill
Text: When entering Combat as the defender, look at the top 5 cards from your Life Deck and put them back on top in any order.

name: Namekian Quick Blast
Text: Focused energy attack doing 5 life cards of damage. If successful, choose up to 4 cards in your discard pile. Remove 2 of them from the game. Shuffle the remaining cards back into your Life Deck. If successful, remove from the game after use.
